rule: the quality menu renders the whole site
title: BITRATE
description: Scrub through five years of work in a live screenshot reel. Change the quality and watch the interface change with it.
signature: Public images hard-cut every two seconds with a 120ms additive colour bleed. The 2021–2026 career scrubber selects real project chapters. A 300ms quality change alters canvas samples, desktop colour depth and type scale; mobile filters remain inside the player. The fact feed and premium state are labelled local recreations.
holdback: The quality transformation earns the additional M5 and a modest Creativity increase to 8.0. The default still remains familiar player chrome around a screenshot, and the desktop career scrubber sits below the first viewport. The deliberate low-quality mode substantially reduces factual density, though Show all facts provides a visible recovery path. The concept is distinctive and usable; it is not at a 9-level composition or observed motion-craft bar.
